title: Sea Horse skin for Skeleton Horses
description: Sea Horse skin for Skeleton Horses by MixelDaPixel
body:
![Seahorse in minecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b9d4ad3074de587ec0bb70fd3ac83dc12693e95.png) ## How To Use **This resorce pack requires the [ETF mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) to work**
In order to get these textures applied you need to rename a skeleton horse to one of these names: - "Red Seahorse" - "Blue Seahorse" - "Yellow Seahorse" - "Pink Seahorse" > **!NOTE!**
> The names are not case-sensitive, so you can name them all lower-case, all upper-case or really any way you want.
